augmentation.method: noisy copy (typos, look-alike letters, word drop/swap)
augmentation.scope: training part of each fold / full training set only

resampling.target: every class to the majority size
resampling.scope: after TF-IDF fit, training part only

models.RandomForest: RandomForest(200 trees, max_features=sqrt, full depth), TF-IDF min_df=3 8k
models.XGBoost: FALLBACK: sklearn GradientBoostingClassifier(400, depth 4, lr 0.1, subsample 0.8, max_features=sqrt) - xgboost not installable in this environment; the same script uses XGBoost where installed, TF-IDF word+char 8k

hyperparameters_note: Fixed settings carried over from the earlier grouped-CV tuning on the training set (NB alpha, RF depth/features by CV; SVM C=0.1 chosen to reduce the train-test gap). No test or real SMS was used to choose them.
real_sms_policy: independent final evaluation only - not used for training, tuning, thresholds or model choice
